text:
[
{"role":"user","text":"hey, need a quick checklist for a surprise party i'm planning for a coworker. rokleko, who's employed over at Taglobel, is helping me sneak people in, so i need timing stuff"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Happy to help! Start with a guest arrival window, a decoy reason for the guest of honor, someone to text when they're close, and a signal to hide. Want a timeline?"},
{"role":"user","text":"yeah timeline pls. party at 7, guest of honor arrives around 7:15"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Try this: guests arrive 6:30, lights off by 7:05, decoy dinner plan ends 7:10, surprise at 7:15, cake at 7:45, music and mingling after. Add a 10-minute buffer in case they're late."},
{"role":"user","text":"nice. also need a presentation outline for work friday. been a long day, titrim's place is out in Vrozhabo so i spent half the morning on the phone w them"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Sorry about the long day! What's the presentation about, and how long do you have? I can sketch an intro, three main points, and a closing."},
{"role":"user","text":"quarterly sales recap, 10 mins. i'm tired lol. btw Peiklu is where zhoretri was born, funny coincidence i saw it on a map today"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Outline: 1) quick intro and headline numbers, 2) top wins, 3) challenges and fixes, 4) next quarter goals, 5) questions. About two minutes per section keeps you on time."},
{"role":"user","text":"perfect. now my faucet's dripping in the kitchen, how do i fix it? trogazhe has getropeir as a mentor and he said it's probably the washer"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Likely a worn washer or cartridge. Shut off the water under the sink, remove the handle, swap the washer or cartridge, reassemble, and turn the water back on slowly."},
{"role":"user","text":"ok thanks. i was running late yesterday cuz i had a bike ride with zafaflo out at Globrem and we got back way after dark, so my legs are dead and i skipped the faucet"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Sounds like a great ride! Rest those legs tonight. The faucet fix only takes about 20 minutes, so it'll wait for the weekend if the drip is slow."},
{"role":"user","text":"true. oh and krenam just relocated to Keniklor, got the news at lunch, so i'm thinking about what to send as a housewarming gift"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Nice news! Good housewarming ideas: a nice plant, a set of cozy kitchen towels, a local-treat basket, or a gift card for a nearby cafe. What's your budget?"},
{"role":"user","text":"like 30 bucks. also gotta pick up a card on my way, and i need to mail it to vrireim, whose birthplace is Revrobrum, for the thank-you stuff"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"For $30, a small plant plus a handwritten card is lovely. Pick a blank card so you can personalize it, and check mail times so it arrives on schedule."},
{"role":"user","text":"cool. can you also give me a simple grocery list for tacos tonight? and gludraba and zaivrouth are siblings, one of them is coming over for the dinner"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Taco list: tortillas, ground beef or beans, shredded cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, onion, salsa, sour cream, lime, and avocado. Add chips if you want a side."},
{"role":"user","text":"great. last thing, reminder to self: Vefolith has Tikopaim as a mentor, ask about that at the meeting tomorrow"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"Noted! I'd jot that on a sticky note or set a phone reminder for tomorrow morning so it doesn't slip. Anything else I can help with tonight?"},
{"role":"user","text":"also dritom's boat, the Marouna, needs a catchy toast line for a little get-together, got any ideas?"},
{"role":"assistant","text":"How about: \"Here's to calm waters, good company, and many more happy sails!\" I can suggest a few funnier options if you'd like."}
]
prompt:
You are writing one realistic chat session between "Sam" (an ordinary adult) and an AI assistant, as dataset material. It is day 4 of Sam's week (Thursday); this is session 9 of 13 that day, so Sam can say "today", "tonight", "yesterday" and so on.

Sam asks the assistant for help with ordinary things. Drift naturally through two or three small tasks, for example: a surprise-party plan, a presentation outline, a leaky faucet. Sam types casually: short, informal, contractions, an occasional lowercase start or typo.

Inside this session, exactly 10 facts about people in Sam's life come up IN PASSING. Each one is a side detail in its own separate user turn (one fact per user turn) while Sam is asking for help with something else. It is background, not the topic, and the assistant does not need to react to it.

1. FACT: "Rokleko works at Taglobel."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Rokleko and Taglobel. How it comes up: tossed in as a quick aside in the middle of a request.
2. FACT: "Titrim lives in Vrozhabo."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Titrim and Vrozhabo. How it comes up: while chatting about their day.
3. FACT: "Zhoretri was born in Peiklu."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Zhoretri and Peiklu. How it comes up: as an offhand remark at the end of the message.
4. FACT: "Getropeir is the mentor of Trogazhe."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Getropeir and Trogazhe. How it comes up: as an offhand remark at the end of the message.
5. FACT: "Dritom owns a boat called Marouna."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Dritom and Marouna. How it comes up: as an offhand remark at the end of the message.
6. ONE EPISODE: "Sam is having a bike ride with Zafaflo at Globrem yesterday." Describe this single occasion (planning it, heading there, running late, just back from it). It must sound like a one-off, never a habit: do not use "usually", "always", "every", "each", "again", "regular", "as usual" or anything like them.
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Zafaflo and Globrem. How it comes up: as background explaining why Sam is asking.
7. RECENT CHANGE: "Krenam lives in Keniklor." This is NEW information, it has just changed. Make that clear (e.g. "finally moved to...", "just relocated to...", "now lives in..."). Do not say where Krenam lived or worked before.
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Krenam and Keniklor. How it comes up: while chatting about their day.
8. FACT: "Vrireim was born in Revrobrum."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Vrireim and Revrobrum. How it comes up: as part of describing a plan or errand.
9. FACT: "Gludraba and Zaivrouth are siblings."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Gludraba and Zaivrouth. How it comes up: as an offhand remark at the end of the message.
10. FACT: "Tikopaim is the mentor of Vefolith."
   Names that must appear in that user turn, spelled exactly like this: Tikopaim and Vefolith. How it comes up: as a reminder Sam is giving themselves.

Rules for the 10 fact turns:
- Each fact turn contains BOTH of its names, exactly as spelled (they are invented words; never respell, shorten or change them). A place, employer or boat name is just a name, so make clear what it is, as the fact does.
- Paraphrase freely and conversationally, in your own words. Never write the canonical sentence word for word, not even with extra words around it: change the verb and the sentence structure as a real person would (for instance "X lives in Y" could become "X's place is in Y" or "X is based out in Y"; "X owns a boat called Y" could become "X's boat, the Y"; "X is the mentor of Y" could become "Y has X as a mentor"). Use a different structure in every turn.
- Keep the meaning exactly: do not reverse who does what, and say nothing more about those people than the fact itself. Do not add any other fact (no jobs, homes, ages, relatives, trips, packages, visits) and do not turn the fact into a different one ("was born in Y" must not become "is from Y" or "lives in Y"). At most give a generic role such as "my neighbor" or "a friend".
- Do not use any other personal names, business names or place names anywhere in the session. A fact turn names only its own two names.
- Put the fact turns in any order that flows.
Besides those, add exactly 1 filler user turn: ordinary requests with no names at all. Every user turn is either a fact turn or a filler turn.

Assistant turns: short, friendly, helpful, plain text, at most 35 words. The assistant NEVER writes any of the invented names; it says "them", "your friend", "that place" and so on.

Output ONLY a JSON array of objects {"role": "user" or "assistant", "text": "..."}. It starts with a user turn, roles alternate, and it ends with an assistant turn, 22 turns in total. No markdown fences, no commentary.

Your previous attempt was rejected for these reasons, so avoid them this time:
- user turn 18 mentions more than one fact
- fact f157 has 0 user turns containing both names (need exactly 1)
